title: Nashville Neighborhood Gem
description:
This 1920's bungalow in historic Sylvan Heights is located just a handful of miles from downtown and Vanderbilt. This is like a duplex.  Your area is the entire original home, more than half of the house, and my area is the addition in the back.  Park in your own driveway; and enjoy the porch.  You get your own bathroom, 2 bedrooms, living room, dining room, and full kitchen.    What are you waiting for?  Come home to Nashville!  See you soon!

The space
You get the front of the house, with its charm and wooden floors, central heat and air.  That includes the driveway, front porch, two private bedrooms, dining room, living room, full kitchen and of course, your own private bath.  I have my own in the back, including a completely separate entrance, which is made of concrete; so I hear nothing.   You get your own keys to the house upon arrival.   I am available if needed, but you aren't likely to see me much.

There are many great restaurants and places to walk to. See "neighborhood overview" section for more. Or you can simply look up L. & L. Restaurant Supply or Sylvan Supply. There are delightful gift shops and Nashville based art and breweries near. So much to see and do!!

Guest access
I will leave keys for you.    Please leave them in the same place when you go.

Other things to note
I am currently seeking a longer term renter.  I need to be away often.  If you book 91 days or more, you are no longer considered "short term". That will save you a lot of taxes right off the top of my already 40% discount for 30 days or more.   I am open to longer term rentals also. Just ask.  I encourage you to contact me regarding dates you do not see available. 

Cleaning Policy

If anyone develops illnesses before, while visiting, or after here, PLEASE let me know right away.  

How clean is it?  I wash ALL of the bedding every time, comforters included. Period.  Bathmats , also. 

Pillows are put in the dryer to kill germs on a regular basis.  I also wash the pillow protectors and the protective mattress covers regularly, curtains too; and I polish the couch and chairs and clean all door handles and surfaces.  I spend way too much time cleaning, but since I clean it myself, I KNOW it’s clean.

host_details:
In the 90's, I moved to Nashville for my love of music.  Since then, I've been fortunate enough to spend lots of time traveling on tour with bands, decorating amazing backstage areas for artists and VIPs to enjoy.   I love creating a comfortable atmosphere that makes everyone feel welcome and relaxed.    

As your Airbnb Host, YOU are my VIP.  I enjoy making things easy for you.  You will feel safe and comfortable here.    I leave days between visits, enjoy the space when guests are not here, and I clean it myself.   

You will always find freshly washed comforters, free coffee, free off street parking, great wireless internet, lots of comfy work spaces, easy self-check-in and out, Roku, extra towels, and lots of wonderful quiet moments on the front porch.  

My “Kate’s Best” list is available upon arrival to guide you to anything you would like to do or see in the state of Tennessee - and even a few other enjoyable day trips in neighboring states.  Did you know Tennessee borders nine states?  So many choices !!  Since I have been here for more than 20 years, I have been to most everything on the list, and I update it regularly.  

As always, I am available via phone for questions or concerns that you may have.  You have a friend in Nashville!  

Come and Enjoy!
Kate
Lives in Nashville, Tennessee
